scope: One-time browser linking and choice-control updates.

topics.title: Link your browser once
details: Set up or reload the extension once. Keep Companion open. Normal website tabs link on their own. You do not need to press Connect for each tab or site.
The extension tries again after a browser or app restart. It follows the active tab. The usual Web browser menu, element keys, lists, tables, typing and dictation remain in place.
Use the extension popup only to check status or pause the link. Browser settings pages are not linked.

topics.title: Use choices with one action
details: Click-based radio widgets use one click. Widgets with keyboard handlers use Space. The reader waits briefly for delayed choice updates without clicking again.
The tests include nested keyboard checkboxes, delayed radio state changes, active tab changes and browser reconnects. Live PayPal sign-in has not been verified. Site security checks still apply.
